//git: feature, bugfix and verdict are permanent worktree branches (CLAUDE.md §4),
not pull-request branches. `mm` pushes them purely as a BACKUP and `zz`
fast-forwards them after every merge, so one deploy was costing four builds
— three of them Preview deployments nobody opens. Only main deploys now.
Pushing a topic branch still backs it up; it just no longer builds.
A NEW branch is NOT covered: this is an explicit per-branch list because
Vercel's deploymentEnabled takes no wildcard. Add the branch here when a
fifth checkout appears, or it will start building Previews silently.
